_comment: Ascendancy node tree. Each ascension grants 1 Ascendancy Point (PrestigeManager). Points are spent here on ranked nodes; every purchased rank's `modifiers` dict is summed and registered through ModifierManager under the single source 'prestige', so the simulation never special-cases Ascendancy. `requires` lists node ids that must have at least one rank before this node unlocks. Keys must exist in ModifierKeys.gd. Reference checks: the test suite validates ids, costs, ranks, requires-graph (acyclic, no dangling) and modifier keys.
